name: DKI Dynamic Location Inserter
author: Farukhkhan

sections.description:
DKI Dynamic Location Inserter allows you to personalize your WordPress landing pages for Google Ads traffic. By dynamically swapping out text based on the user’s location, you instantly increase ad relevance, lower your bounce rate, and boost conversions.

When a user clicks your Google Ad, this plugin reads the location parameter from your URL and updates your page content automatically. If a user from Chicago clicks your ad, your headline can automatically change to “Best Services in Chicago.”

🌟 Free Features

  • Dynamic Location Shortcode: Use [dki_location default="Your Area"] anywhere on your site.
  • 30 Built-In US Cities: Ready to use out of the box. Includes major Google Ads Geo Targets like New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, and more.
  • Page Builder Support: Works seamlessly with the standard WordPress editor, Elementor, Bricks Builder, and more.
  • Zero Configuration: No databases to upload or API keys to configure. Just install and use the shortcode.

🚀 Need Keyword Insertion & Analytics?

The free version focuses purely on Location Insertion for major US hubs. If you need exact Search Keyword Insertion, global location databases, and live conversion tracking, check out the PRO version at dkiplugin.com.

🌟 Lite Version Features

  • Dynamic Location Shortcode: Use [dki_location default="Your Area"] anywhere on your site.
  • 30 Built-In US Cities: Ready to use out of the box. Includes major Google Ads Geo Targets like New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, and more.
  • Page Builder Support: Works seamlessly with the standard WordPress editor, Elementor, Bricks Builder, and more.
  • Zero Configuration: No databases to upload or API keys to configure. Just install and use the shortcode.

🚀 Upgrade to PRO

The Lite version is perfect for local campaigns targeting major US hubs. For global campaigns, exact keyword insertion, and analytics, upgrade to DKI PRO.

PRO Features Include:
* Dynamic Keyword Insertion: Unlock the [dki_keyword] shortcode to dynamically insert the exact search term the user typed into Google.
* Global Geo Database: Upload Google’s official CSV to support over 100,000+ global cities, regions, and zip codes.
* Conversion Tracking Dashboard: A beautiful, real-time analytics dashboard tracking exactly which locations are converting.
* User Action Logs: Track form submissions (CF7, Elementor, Bricks) and “Click to Call” button presses with exact visitor IP and location data.
* Active Usage Audit: Automatically scan your entire website to find exactly which pages are actively using your shortcodes.

Get PRO Today!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dynamic-keyword-insertion-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode [dki_location default="Your City"] on any landing page.
  4. Set up your Google Ads tracking template with: ?geo_loc={loc_physical_ms}
  5. That’s it! When users click your ad, their city name will dynamically populate.
sections.faq:
Does this work with Elementor or Bricks Builder?

Yes! The shortcodes are processed using standard WordPress rendering, meaning they will work perfectly inside Text, Heading, and HTML modules in modern page builders like Elementor and Bricks Builder.

What cities are included in the Lite version?

The Lite version includes the top 30 US Google Ads Geo Targets (e.g., New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, Miami, etc.). If a user visits from a location not in this list, the shortcode will safely display your fallback text (e.g., “Your City”). To unlock all 100,000+ global locations, upgrade to PRO.

How do I pass the location from Google Ads?

In your Google Ads campaign settings, locate the “Tracking template” or “Final URL suffix” field and append ?geo_loc={loc_physical_ms}. Google will automatically swap {loc_physical_ms} with the user’s actual location ID when they click your ad.

How do I track conversions?

Conversion tracking, dashboard analytics, and user action logs are exclusive features of PRO.
